name: Blaster
description: A beam of charged particles that inflicts impact damage.

name: Close Weapons
description: Weapons for close combat, often with cultural or ceremonial significance.

name: Control Pod
description: Attaches to the skin to control the mind of the victim.

name: Containment Pod
description: Keeps creatures in suspended animation for later revival.

name: Environment Suit
description: Provides life support for different environments.
effects: Immunity (Cold, Heat, Pressure, Radiation, Suffocation, Vacuum)

name: Force Cell
description: Prison cells made of force fields, capable of withstanding superhuman might.

name: Gun-Jamming Field
description: Renders chemical propellant weapons useless in a given area.

name: Communicator
description: A communications device that transmits an encrypted signal.

name: Examination Suite
description: Uses sensors to examine living subjects for scientific or military purposes.
effects: Senses (Detect Life Form, Acute, Analytical, Microscopic Vision, Penetrates Concealment, Rapid)

name: Mind Probe
description: Delves into the deepest recesses of the subject's mind.

name: Universal Translator
description: Automatically provides translations from a vast database of languages.

name: Chameleon Cloak
description: Creates the realistic illusion of a human appearance.

name: Cloaking Device
description: Allows the wearer or vehicle to vanish from sight.

name: Mind Mask
description: Masks the wearer's unique thoughts and brain patterns from detection.

name: Teleporter
description: Instantly transports the user from one location to another.

name: Dagger
description: A small, sharp, piercing weapon.

name: Sword
description: A long-bladed weapon used for slashing.

name: Axe
description: A heavy weapon with a sharp edge for slashing.

name: Club
description: A simple wooden club used for bludgeoning.

name: Hammer
description: A heavy hammer for delivering powerful blows.

name: Mace
description: A metal club with a heavy head for smashing.

name: Flail
description: A weapon with a spiked head attached to a chain.

name: Staff
description: A long wooden staff for striking and blocking.

name: Javelin
description: A light spear designed for throwing.

name: Spear
description: A long weapon with a pointed tip for thrusting.

name: Trident
description: A three-pronged spear used for thrusting and trapping.

name: Bolos
description: A throwing weapon designed to entangle the target's legs.

name: Net
description: A net used to entangle and immobilize the target.

name: Whip
description: A long, flexible whip used for striking, disarming, and grabbing.

name: Bow
description: A bow used for shooting arrows at a distance.

name: Crossbow
description: A weapon that shoots bolts using a mechanical trigger.

name: Sling
description: A simple weapon for hurling stones or bullets.

name: Leather Armor
description: Simple armor made from hardened leather.

name: Chain-mail Armor
description: A type of armor consisting of small metal rings linked together in a pattern to form a mesh.

name: Laminate Armor
description: Armor made from layers of material laminated together.

name: Plate-mail Armor
description: Armor made from large metal plates.

name: Full-plate Armor
description: A complete suit of plate armor covering the entire body.

name: Hook Sword
description: Curved hooks at the end of the blade, effective at tripping, catching opposing weapons, and blocking.

name: Kama
description: A weapon adapted from a small sickle, often wielded in pairs.

name: Katana
description: The famous 'samurai sword' wielded by noble warriors in feudal Japan.

name: Katar
description: The Indian 'punch dagger' with an H-shaped grip.

name: Kris
description: An Indonesian dagger with a distinctive wavy blade design.

name: Kukri
description: A heavy Nepalese knife with an inward curving edge.

name: Ninja-to
description: A short straight sword carried and used by ninja.

name: Sai
description: Tapering metal batons often wielded in pairs with curved side prongs.

name: Wakizashi
description: The shorter companion blade to a katana, useful for close-in fighting.

name: War Fan
description: A weapon based on the folding fans, can be wielded closed or open.

name: Wind and Fire Wheels
description: Chinese weapons consisting of metal rings with flame-styled blades.

name: Injected
description: The effect must be injected into the target’s body in order to work. This means it must first penetrate the target’s skin or outer surface, typically using a needle or other injector.

name: Treatment Tools
description: The most common role biochemicals play is as a part of the tools used with the Treatment skill for dealing with injuries and illnesses.

name: Wonder Drugs
description: Comic books are full of “miracle pills” and “super-serums” with amazing effects, especially in the Golden and Silver Ages before the “war on drugs.”

name: Tailored Toxins
description: Other biochemicals are baneful brews, usually cooked up by villains and functioning as a poison of one kind or another.

name: Disease
description: Most diseases in superhero settings are either handled as extended complications or as specific powers inflicting fast-acting disease symptoms on targets as an Affliction, for example.

name: Micro-Monsters
description: A common comic book element is heroes shrunk down to microscopic scale faced with invading microbes or even white blood cells convinced they are invaders!

name: Duplication
description: A clone can be force-grown from a still-living person in order to create a living duplicate.

name: Empowerment
description: If super-powers have a genetic basis, then genetic engineering may be able to isolate the genes and sequences that grant certain powers and deliberately engineer people who have them.

name: Uplifting
description: Uplifting is the process of granting sentience to non-sentient species (or individual members of a species).
effect: Adding higher Intellect and Presence ranks

name: Chimeras
description: A chimera is an organism made up of cells with distinct genetic differences, that is, some of its cells are genetically unrelated to others.

name: Biomanufacturing
description: Living creatures are powerful “factories” for the production of many biochemicals, consuming food (and, in the case of photosynthetic life, sunlight) and producing biomass and waste products.

name: Self-Maintaining Items
description: Growth and healing are primary qualities of life that biotechnology seeks to emulate.

name: Living Vessels
description: Biotechnology may virtually erase the lines between creature, construct, and vehicle in M&M game terms, creating creatures modified for use as a form of transportation.

name: Investigative Computer
description: A computer designed as an aid for Investigation skill use, providing a circumstance bonus on checks to analyze evidence.

name: Installation Computer
description: A dedicated computer system for an installation, capable of overseeing its functions and automation.

name: Navigational Computer
description: A computer able to determine position and plot routes to known destinations, usually via GPS.

name: Targeting Computer
description: A computer that calculates variables involved in aiming a ranged weapon, improving the user's aim.

name: Tactical Computer
description: A system linking sensors to software to calculate advantageous tactics, providing information via HUD.

name: Vehicle Computer
description: A dedicated computer system for a vehicle, allowing for autopilot and remote control.

name: Virtual Reality
description: A computer-generated simulation of a real or imaginary experience, interfaced with via various means.

name: Neural Boosters
description: Rewired and enhanced central nervous system with superconductors, signal boosters, and computer sub-processors for faster response time.

name: Targeting System
description: Range finders, sensors, and targeting software linked to the central nervous system for greater accuracy in ranged attacks.

name: Skeletal Reinforcement
description: Skeleton reinforced or replaced with durable materials like diamond-analog carbon molecules, making bones virtually unbreakable.
effects: Immunity (Bludgeoning Damage) Limited to Half Effect

name: Skinmorph
description: Artificial skin capable of shifting appearance, including features, skin tone, and texture.
effects: Morph (people of your size and gender)

name: Stinger
description: Drug injector designed to inject others, concealed in a fingertip or inside the mouth.
effects: Affliction (Resisted by Fortitude; various conditions) Cumulative, Resistible (Toughness)

name: Cyberears
description: Ears enhanced or replaced with implants providing various auditory senses and potentially immunity to hearing-dependent attacks.

name: Cybereyes
description: Eyes enhanced or replaced with implants providing various visual senses and potentially immunity to vision-dependent attacks.

name: Cyberhair
description: Artificial hair fibers capable of animation and changing color and texture, functioning like an additional prehensile limb.

name: Cerebral Cache
description: Slaved computer memory system providing additional mental processing power and memory storage.

name: Chemical Analyzer
description: Tongue and sinuses enhanced with chemical analyzers for enhanced olfactory senses.
effects: Senses (Olfactory) Acute or Accurate and Analytical

name: Cybervox
description: Modified or replaced voice box capable of mimicking sounds and voices, and potentially other sonic powers.

name: Headlink
description: Implanted radio communicator connected to auditory nerves for subvocal communication.

name: Interface Jack
description: Input/output port for interfacing with computers and networks, providing direct brain-computer interaction.

name: Persona Backup
description: Automatic backup system for memories and personality, allowing for transfer to a new body upon death.

name: Skill Software
description: Ability to download pre-programmed skill and advantage models into the mind.

name: Blaster Pistol
description: A handheld energy weapon firing charged particles.

name: Blaster Rifle
description: A larger energy weapon with a stock and longer barrel for greater accuracy and power.

name: Flamethrower
description: A weapon that sprays burning fuel at targets.

name: Ice Gun
description: A weapon that fires a beam of cold energy to freeze targets.
effect: Ranged Affliction 8 (ice; Hindered, Vulnerable, Defenseless, Immobilized)

name: Laser Pistol
description: A handheld weapon that fires a concentrated beam of light.

name: Microwave Disruptor
description: A weapon that fires a beam of microwaves to disrupt electronics.
effect: Ranged Weaken Electronics 6 Broad Simultaneous Accurate

name: Plasma Burst
description: A weapon that fires a burst of super-heated plasma.

name: Sonic Stunner
description: A weapon that uses sound frequencies to stun targets.

name: X-ray Laser Sniper Rifle
description: A sniper rifle that fires a beam of X-ray radiation.
effect: Subtle Ranged Damage 8 (radiation) Penetrating 5 Accurate Dangerous Extended Range

name: Electro-Whip
description: A whip that delivers an electric shock on contact.

name: Grav Gauntlet
description: A gauntlet that uses gravity manipulation to enhance the wearer's punches.

name: Laser Sword
description: A sword with a blade made of pure energy.

name: Shock Baton
description: A baton that delivers an electric shock on contact.

name: Sonic Knife
description: A knife that uses sonic vibrations to cut through materials.

name: Holdout Pistol
description: A small, easily concealed low-caliber weapon.

name: Light Pistol
description: A common semi-automatic handgun used by police officers.

name: Heavy Pistol
description: A high-caliber handgun such as a .357 Magnum.

name: Rifle
description: A long-barrelled firearm fired with both hands, used for hunting and target shooting.

name: Rifle High-Power
description: A high-caliber rifle with greater range and accuracy.

name: Sniper Rifle
description: A rifle designed for use at greater range, often with accessories like a targeting scope.

name: Assault Rifle
description: An automatic weapon with settings for single shot, burst, and fully automatic fire.

name: Shotgun
description: A firearm that can fire solid slugs or shot, typically used for hunting and law enforcement.
effect: Ranged Damage 5 (Accurate 2 ranks Limited to targets without Protection)

name: Machine Pistol
description: An automatic carbine or pistol that can be fired with one or both hands.

name: Submachine Gun
description: An automatic weapon with enhanced effectiveness due to its ability to fire multiple rounds with a single trigger pull.

name: Air Gun
description: A non-lethal weapon that fires a blast of compressed air.

name: Dart Gun
description: A weapon that fires small hypodermic darts to deliver drugs or poisons.
effect: Ranged Affliction (Impaired, Disabled, Incapacitated; Resistible by Toughness)

name: Flare Gun
description: A signaling device that fires a brightly glowing flare.

name: Taser
description: A weapon that fires a pair of darts releasing a powerful electrical charge.

name: Paintball Gun
description: A sporting weapon that fires gel pellets filled with paint or dye.

name: Light Machine Gun
description: A fully automatic weapon designed for mobility and rate of fire.

name: Medium Machine Gun
description: A belt-fed automatic weapon with increased firepower.

name: Heavy Machine Gun
description: A high-caliber automatic weapon with devastating firepower.

name: Cannon
description: A large, mounted gun designed to fire heavy projectiles.

name: Howitzer
description: A type of artillery piece characterized by a relatively short barrel and the use of comparatively small propellant charges to propel projectiles over high trajectories.

name: Guided Missile
description: A self-propelled weapon that can adjust its trajectory during flight to hit a specific target.

name: Cruise Missile
description: A guided missile used primarily for attacking land and sea targets.

name: Torpedo
description: A self-propelled underwater missile designed to detonate on contact with or in proximity to a target.

name: Advanced Torpedo
description: A highly advanced and more powerful version of a conventional torpedo.

name: Tactical Nuclear Weapon
description: A nuclear weapon designed for use in battlefield tactical situations.

name: Strategic Nuclear Weapon
description: A nuclear weapon designed for long-range use, typically to target cities or large military formations.

name: Eye of Argon
description: A darkling gemstone housing a malign intelligence, transforming the wielder into the villainess Opal.

name: Mask of the Modrossus
description: Transforms the wearer into a living avatar of the Modrossus, the greatest mystical force for order.
effects: Enhanced Advantages 7 (Benefit (guidance from the Modrossus), Fearless, Luck 5)
Enhanced Magic 20 (adds 20 points to existing Magic array)
Senses 9 (Cosmic Awareness, Detect Magic (Acute, Analytical, Extended 3, Ranged), Magic Awareness)

name: Medallion of the Modrossus
description: A powerful talisman of light and truth against the forces of darkness and chaos.
effects: Three Dynamic Alternate Effects: Ranged Affliction (blinding light; Impaired, Disabled, Unaware), Cumulative, Limited to Vision

name: Philosopher's Stone
description: The ultimate instrument of alchemy, capable of transmuting elements.

name: Scrying Stone of Sirrion
description: Allows remote sensing and detection of evil and magic.
effects: Senses 9 (Detect Evil 2, Detect Magic 2, Magical Awareness, Vision Counters Concealment and Illusion; Expertise: Magic Check Required, DC 13)

name: Serpent Scepter
description: A creation of the ancient Serpent Empire, capable of controlling minds and transforming beings into Serpent People.
effects: Perception Range Burst Area Affliction 20 (Resisted and Overcome by Will; Entranced, Compelled, Controlled; Extra Condition (controlled subjects undergo slow transformation into Serpent People with one resistance check per day), Progressive)
Side-Effect (wielder suffers from complications and Extra Condition effect)

name: Base of Operations
description: A base of operations provides a place for heroes to rest, train, and prepare for their adventures.

name: Command Center
description: A command center is equipped with advanced technology for monitoring and managing operations.

name: Laboratory
description: A laboratory is a dedicated space for scientific research and experimentation.

name: Prison
description: A prison is designed to securely contain and manage criminals.

name: Safe House
description: A safe house provides a secure location for heroes to hide or recover.

name: Training Facility
description: A training facility is equipped with various equipment and environments for honing skills and abilities.

name: Vehicle Hangar
description: A vehicle hangar provides storage and maintenance space for vehicles.

name: Workshop
description: A workshop is a space equipped with tools and equipment for building and repairing gadgets.

name: Adaptive Camouflage
description: Nanobots that alter the color and texture of the wearer's clothing or skin to blend in with the environment.

name: Combat Swarm
description: A cloud of nanobots programmed to swarm and attack targets.

name: Disassembler Cloud
description: Nanobots designed to break down materials at the molecular level.

name: Healing Swarm
description: Nanobots programmed to repair tissue and heal wounds.

name: Nano-Blade
description: A blade formed from densely packed nanobots, capable of cutting through almost anything.

name: Nano-Communicator
description: A communication device utilizing nanobots for enhanced signal clarity and encryption.

name: Nano-Disruptor
description: A weapon that fires a stream of disruptive nanobots, capable of short-circuiting electronics.

name: Nano-Sensor Array
description: A set of sensors enhanced with nanotechnology for precise measurements and analysis.

name: Reconstruction Swarm
description: Nanobots that can rapidly assemble or disassemble objects at the molecular level.

name: Self-Replicating Nanobots
description: Nanobots capable of replicating themselves to repair or create new structures.

name: Energy Control
description: Manipulate a particular form of energy, such as fire, electricity, or radiation.
effects: Array (Energy Blast, Energy Construct, Energy Shield, etc.)

name: Flight
description: Ability to fly through the air at various speeds.

name: Invisibility
description: Render oneself unseen to the naked eye.

name: Mind Control
description: Control the actions of others through mental domination.

name: Regeneration
description: Heal injuries and recover from damage at an accelerated rate.

name: Shape Shifting
description: Alter one's physical form to mimic other people or creatures.

name: Super Strength
description: Possess physical strength far beyond human limits.

name: Telekinesis
description: Manipulate objects and matter with one's mind.

name: Telepathy
description: Communicate with others and read minds using mental abilities.

name: Teleportation
description: Instantly transport oneself and others to different locations.

name: Aura Sight
description: A device that allows the user to see psychic auras, revealing emotions and other mental states.

name: Mind Shield
description: A protective psychic barrier that shields the mind from intrusion and influence.

name: Psi-Blade
description: A blade of psychic energy that can cut through mental defenses.

name: Psychic Blast
description: A focused blast of psychic energy that can overwhelm the minds of targets.

name: Telekinetic Field
description: A field of psychic energy that can manipulate objects and create barriers.

name: Telepathic Communicator
description: A device that facilitates telepathic communication over long distances.

name: Thought Detector
description: A device that can detect and interpret the thoughts of others.

name: Battle Drone
description: A small, agile drone equipped with weapons for combat.

name: Construction Bot
description: A robot designed for construction and repair tasks.

name: Hazardous Environment Drone
description: A drone designed to operate in extreme conditions, such as high radiation or toxic environments.

name: Medical Droid
description: A robot equipped with medical tools and knowledge to provide first aid and medical care.

name: Reconnaissance Drone
description: A small, stealthy drone used for surveillance and reconnaissance missions.

name: Security Bot
description: A robot designed for security and patrol duties, equipped with sensors and defensive systems.

name: Utility Drone
description: A versatile drone equipped with tools for various tasks, such as repair, manipulation, and data collection.

name: Bug Detector
description: A device used to detect and locate hidden surveillance bugs.
effects: Senses (Detect Electronic Surveillance, Ranged, Acute, Analytical)

name: Concealed Holster
description: A holster designed to conceal a small firearm or other weapon.

name: Decryption Software
description: Software used to decrypt encrypted data and communications.

name: Disguise Kit
description: A kit containing various items used for creating disguises.

name: Eavesdropping Device
description: A device used to listen in on conversations and other sounds from a distance.

name: Encryption Software
description: Software used to encrypt data and communications.

name: False Identity
description: A set of false identification papers and credentials.

name: Lock Picks
description: A set of tools used for picking locks.

name: Miniature Camera
description: A small camera used for covert surveillance.

name: Poison Detector
description: A device used to detect the presence of poison in food or drink.

name: Safe-Cracking Tools
description: A set of tools used for breaking into safes.

name: Secret Compartment
description: A hidden compartment used to conceal items.

name: Silencer
description: An attachment for a firearm that reduces the sound of gunfire.

name: Voice Changer
description: A device used to alter the user's voice.

name: Steam-Powered Exoskeleton
description: A wearable mechanical suit powered by steam, enhancing the wearer's strength and durability.

name: Steam Cannon
description: A large cannon that uses steam pressure to launch projectiles at high velocity.

name: Steam-Powered Carriage
description: A carriage driven by a steam engine, capable of transporting passengers at moderate speeds.

name: Steam Rifle
description: A rifle powered by steam pressure, capable of firing bullets with considerable force.

name: Steam-Powered Automaton
description: A mechanical construct powered by steam, capable of performing simple tasks autonomously.

name: Steam Jetpack
description: A backpack-mounted device that uses steam pressure to propel the wearer into the air.

name: Steam-Powered Drill
description: A heavy-duty drill powered by steam, capable of boring through tough materials.

name: Steam Clock
description: A precision clockwork mechanism powered by steam, known for its accuracy and reliability.

name: Steam-Powered Grappling Hook
description: A grappling hook launcher powered by steam, allowing for quick ascension or traversal.

name: Steam-Powered Hammer
description: A powerful hammer driven by steam, used for construction or demolition.

name: Steam-Powered Locomotive
description: A train engine powered by steam, capable of pulling carriages along railway tracks.

name: Steam-Powered Water Pump
description: A pump that uses steam power to move water, useful for irrigation or firefighting.

name: Car
description: A standard automobile for personal transportation.

name: Motorcycle
description: A two-wheeled vehicle for fast and agile transportation.

name: Tank
description: A heavily armored combat vehicle with a powerful cannon.

name: Helicopter
description: A rotary-wing aircraft for versatile aerial transportation.

name: Jet Fighter
description: A high-speed military aircraft designed for aerial combat.

name: Speedboat
description: A fast boat designed for racing or quick transportation on water.

name: Submarine
description: An underwater vehicle designed for stealth and exploration.

name: Space Shuttle
description: A spacecraft designed for travel to and from orbit.

name: Hoverbike
description: A futuristic bike that hovers above the ground for fast travel.

name: ATV
description: An all-terrain vehicle designed for off-road travel.
